visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a gray long-sleeved shirt, stands in a brightly lit bedroom holding two jackets on white hangers—one dark charcoal/green and one black. Behind her is a white wall featuring a large black-and-white 2024 January calendar. (2) She moves the jackets closer to the camera to show the fabric texture and design details while using hand gestures to emphasize points. The lighting is even and bright, illuminating the room's white furniture and tidy bed. (3) The woman puts on the black jacket, demonstrating its high collar, oversized fit, and hidden closure system. She turns sideways and backward to show the garment's profile and volume. (4) A young man wearing a black beanie and a white t-shirt appears, modeling the dark charcoal jacket in the same room. He shows the front and side views before the woman returns to holding both jackets for the final segment.
